items.t: Newegg Brings Free In-Person Tech Help, Order Pickup, and Return Drop-Off to Southern California
items.sum: DIAMOND BAR, Calif., November 09, 2026--Newegg (Newegg Commerce, Inc., NASDAQ: NEGG), a global leader in computer and technology products, today announced the opening of the Newegg Service Center in Ontario, California.
